children: ALPHARETTA, Ga., Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Flip Electronics, a global authorized distributor specializing in hard-to-find, discontinued LTB, EOL, aged, and obsolete electronic components, today announced it has signed an authorized distribution partnership agreement with

. Through this agreement, Flip Electronics will distribute an expansive portfolio of Littelfuse EOL, obsolete, aged, and excess devices, supporting innovation across industrial, military, aerospace, transportation, and medical markets.

"We are committed to supporting customers throughout the product lifecycle, and making our end-of-life (EOL) and obsolete product portfolio available through Flip Electronics is an important part of that commitment. Their customer-focused approach and dedication to addressing obsolescence and long-term supply chain challenges make them an ideal partner for supporting our legacy and EOL customer base." Said Crystal Sensenbrenner, Vice President of Global Distribution at Littelfuse, Inc.

Jason Murphy, CEO of Flip Electronics, added, "Littelfuse has built a strong reputation for innovation and reliability, and we're honored to become an authorized distribution partner. This agreement strengthens our ability to support customers with continued access to critical end-of-life, obsolete, and hard-to-find components through an authorized supply chain. Together, we're helping OEMs extend product lifecycles, reduce supply chain risk, and keep essential systems operating across the industries we serve."

is a global authorized distributor of electronic components, focused on delivering factory-direct, fully traceable components for high-reliability applications. Flip specializes in obsolescence mitigation, extended-life manufacturing, lifecycle extension, and obsolescence solutions for markets where quality and authenticity are critical. Flip Electronics supports a wide range of industries, including aerospace, defense, industrial, EMS, automotive, transportation, and medical, by providing authorized, traceable electronic components and innovative solutions to combat obsolescence and supply chain disruption.
